summary: QA stability sweep on Expo web preview (http://localhost:3000) at mobile viewport 390x844. Auth (Welcome → Login → demo maggie → Home), Signup back via header-back testID, Bottom tabs (Home/Lounge/Friends/Profile), Coffee Lounge per-table navigation, Events list + new form, Admin index (summary/reports/repeats/tickets), Admin user review (warn/suspend/ban/note), Profile chat-alert modal (My friends / Nearby opt-ins / Choose people), User profile Report+Block testIDs, Notifications + Messages routes — ALL CORE FLOWS WORK. Two notable findings on /admin/user/[id]: (a) NO 'Restore' button is rendered (spec says Warn/Suspend/Ban/Restore — Restore is missing from the UI even though backend POST /api/admin/users/restore exists per credentials doc); (b) the moderation review header shows the moderated user as '—' / '@' / 'Suburb hidden' with 0 Reports / 0 Open / 0 Actions — the admin cannot see who they are reviewing or any history. The page is fetching but rendering an empty/sanitised snapshot; likely a JSON-shape mismatch between /api/admin/users/{id}/moderation response and what the React page expects. Also confirmed: the previously reported 'all Join Table buttons do the same thing' bug is NOT REPRODUCIBLE in current build — first card → /table/e1aee60f… , second card → /table/add8d205… (distinct IDs). welcome-apple & welcome-google buttons exist and only fire a 'coming soon' toast — informational only per the brief.

ui_bugs.issue: Moderation review page renders user as '—' / '@' / 'Suburb hidden' and shows 0 Reports / 0 Open / 0 Actions for users that the Repeat-offenders list shows as having multiple reports. The page IS loading (admin-note-input, admin-add-note, admin-warn, admin-ban testIDs render) but the user profile snapshot and report/action history are empty. Likely cause: response shape from GET /api/admin/users/{id}/moderation doesn't match the keys the screen reads, OR the screen reads `user` but the API returns `target_user`/`profile`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/user/[id].tsx vs server.py admin moderation endpoint. Page URL: /admin/user/<any repeat-offender id>

NO 'Restore' button is rendered. Spec explicitly says 'Warn/Suspend/Ban/Restore buttons'. Current UI only shows: Add note, Warn, Suspend 24h, Suspend 72h, Ban. Restore endpoint exists in backend (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md) but no UI button to call it — admin cannot undo a suspend/ban from the in-app review screen. Page URL: /admin/user/<id>

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/admin/users/{id}/moderation appears to return data but the frontend doesn't bind report_history / moderation_log / user.first_name / user.username — every field renders blank. Need to confirm API contract vs UI binding.

issues: Empty placeholder ('—' and '@') with no visual fallback or error state when data is missing — looks broken rather than 'unavailable'.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. (React Native Web). Reference: pervasive across StyleSheet.create blocks in welcome (index.tsx), lounge.tsx, events.tsx, etc. Not a crash but noisy and will become an error in future RN-Web versions.
Console warns: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow'. Reference: index.tsx styles.tag1 (textShadowColor/Offset/Radius).
Console warns: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. (React Native Web). Originates inside @react-navigation transitions but worth flagging.

Console: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' This is expected for the placeholder push scaffold but worth gating the listener registration on Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence the warning.

action_items: FIX (major): /admin/user/[id] page binding — confirm the GET /api/admin/users/{id}/moderation response keys (user / reports / warnings / moderation_log / counts per test_credentials.md) match what /app/frontend/app/admin/user/[id].tsx reads. Currently all fields render empty for known repeat-offenders, so admin cannot see WHO they are moderating or their history.

FIX (major): Add a 'Restore' action button to /admin/user/[id] (testID `admin-restore`) that calls POST /api/admin/users/restore. Without it, admins must use Mongo or backend to clear suspensions/bans.
CLEANUP (low): Add a Platform.OS guard around expo-notifications addPushTokenListener so the 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' warning stops on every page load.

CLEANUP (low, polish): Migrate shadow* / textShadow* / pointerEvents style props to boxShadow / textShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence React Native Web deprecation warnings. Pervasive — at minimum in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx, /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/lounge.tsx, /app/frontend/app/events.tsx.

INFORMATIONAL: welcome-apple and welcome-google buttons exist on the Welcome screen and only fire a 'coming soon' toast (handleSocial in index.tsx:42-44). Per the brief these are NOT to be reported as bugs — flagged here only because the user thinks they work.

INFORMATIONAL: The previously reported 'all Join Table buttons do the same thing' bug is NOT REPRODUCIBLE in current build. Confirmed each Pressable card in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/lounge.tsx routes to its own /table/{item.id}. Two distinct table cards navigated to two distinct table IDs (e1aee60f… vs add8d205…). If user still sees this, it may be cached app state — ask them to clear app data and retest.
critical_code_review_comments: lounge.tsx — there is no per-card explicit 'Join' button; the whole Pressable card (testID `table-{id}`) opens /table/{id}. The visual 'Take a Seat' / 'Start a Chat' pill is decorative only. This is actually a STRENGTH because it eliminates the risk of multiple onPress closures capturing the wrong table id (a common cause of the 'all buttons do the same thing' bug). Recommend keeping this pattern.

events/new.tsx — Date and Time are free-text TextInputs with regex validators. On mobile this is OK but error-prone for senior users (target audience). Consider a calendar / time picker (react-native-modal-datetime-picker or @react-native-community/datetimepicker) — non-blocking polish item.
events.tsx:76 — Edit pencil visibility correctly uses `(user.id === item.host_id || (user as any).is_admin)`. Solid.
admin/index.tsx:33 — `api.adminRepeatOffenders(user.id, 2, 30)` — threshold=2 unique reporters surfaces watched users alongside flagged (3+) ones; matches the 'Repeat (12)' tab count seen. OK.

Welcome handleSocial only shows a toast — no analytics / no error. Once Apple/Google land, swap the toast for a real provider call. Don't forget to remove the welcome-apple / welcome-google testIDs if buttons are removed.

signup.tsx — header-back testID is present and works. Multi-step (the legacy 'every step' from the brief) doesn't apply: signup is one long scrollable form, not stepped. So 'back from every step' = single back action, which works.
Profile chat-alert modal — all three audiences render and the toggle-nearby-opt-in testID exists. Confirm preferences persist after reload (couldn't test in one run without seeding state).

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-priority sweep — backend endpoints exercised indirectly via UI all returned data; admin/users/{id}/moderation response binding suspected but not isolated)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% — All routes load, no red screen, no JS crashes, no dead-end back nav; 2 issues on /admin/user/[id] (empty user info + missing Restore button).

seed_data_creation: None. Only read paths used. Demo login session (maggie) created in-browser, no DB mutations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Once main agent fixes /admin/user/[id] (user header empty + missing Restore button), re-open /admin → Repeat tab → tap any admin-review-<id> and verify: (1) user emoji/first_name/username render, (2) Report history > 0 entries, (3) Moderation history shows past warn/suspend actions, (4) `admin-restore` testID is present and POSTs to /api/admin/users/restore. Also: write an end-to-end 3-reports-from-3-users test that asserts the target user gets profile_hidden=true and disappears from /api/users public list — couldn't trigger in this UI run without seeding 3 demo sessions.
rca_of_issue: CONFIRMED via backend logs: GET /api/admin/users/1095b964-ca05-40a3-a1ee-d5056e34b7ab/moderation?admin_id=<maggie> returns **404 Not Found**, NOT a malformed body. The Repeat-Offenders endpoint (/api/admin/repeat-offenders) is surfacing user_ids that do NOT exist in db.users — likely orphaned target_user_id references from seed reports against deleted/fake test users (the repeats list shows usernames like 'Victim_1abe5ebf' which look like test data). The frontend page renders nothing because the API 404s and the catch swallows it. TWO fixes needed: (1) Backend: /api/admin/repeat-offenders should LEFT-JOIN against db.users and either (a) skip orphan reports or (b) return a `is_orphan:true` flag so the UI can show 'User deleted'. Also /api/admin/users/{id}/moderation should return a stub 404 body the UI can render. (2) Frontend: /admin/user/[id].tsx must show an explicit error state when the GET 404s — currently it renders an empty card which looks like a bug to admins. Missing Restore button: not implemented in the page yet (only Warn/Suspend24/Suspend72/Ban Pressables visible in screenshot). Add a fifth Pressable with testID=admin-restore that calls api.adminRestore(user.id, target_user_id, reason).
